# Lesson Hollow

> Lesson Hollow is an online dashboard for homeschool families with AI assistance for managing curricula. Parents build or import curricula, enroll children (called players), and track daily learning tasks. The platform includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants create curriculums, enroll children, and work the daily task list. One parent account can follow up to 20 children. The app is open source under the MIT license.

## Pricing

Pay as you go with no subscription or auto-renewal. No credit card required to sign up. Each child's first curriculum enrollment is free. After that, enrollments cost $0.50 each, sold as $10 for 20 credits.

- [Pricing](https://lessonhollow.com/pricing): Full pricing details and how credits work.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://lessonhollow.com/): Overview of Lesson Hollow for homeschool families, microschool guides, and self-directed learners.
- [Discover](https://lessonhollow.com/discover): Browse free ready-made curriculums and enroll your children.

## Discover Curriculums

Free curriculums families can enroll in and start tracking daily:

- [K-8 American History](https://lessonhollow.com/discover/k-8-american-history): A chronological path through American history in 214 hand-picked picture books and videos.
- [52 Library Visits in 52 Weeks](https://lessonhollow.com/discover/52-library-visits-in-52-weeks): A year-long library adventure with weekly quests for discovery and creativity.
- [Introduction to Personal Curriculum](https://lessonhollow.com/discover/introduction-to-personal-curriculum): A starter course for building your own personal curriculum on any topic.
- [Computer Skills for Kids](https://lessonhollow.com/discover/computer-skills-for-kids): Essential computer skills from typing to email to basic coding.
- [Standard Algorithms](https://lessonhollow.com/discover/standard-algorithms): Master the standard algorithms for arithmetic.
- [Great Americans for Ages 3 to 7](https://lessonhollow.com/discover/great-americans-ages-3-7): Picture book introductions to notable Americans for young children.
- [Iain Banks Galactic Civilization Starter Pack](https://lessonhollow.com/discover/iain-banks-galactic-civilization-starter-pack): A reading path through Iain M. Banks' Culture novels.
- [Augmented Reality Quests on Meta Quest 3](https://lessonhollow.com/discover/augmented-reality-quests-meta-quest-3): Hands-on augmented reality learning activities.

## AI and Large Language Model Integration

- [Building a Curriculum File (Large Language Model Prompt)](https://lessonhollow.com/help/llm/building-a-curriculum-file): A copy-and-paste prompt for ChatGPT, Claude, or another large language model that writes importable curriculum CSV files.
- [Using Open Source Curriculum Files](https://lessonhollow.com/help/llm/using-open-source-curriculum-files): Access real curriculum CSV examples and format documentation in the GitHub repository.

## MCP Server

Lesson Hollow includes a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that allows AI assistants to manage learning programmatically. The server supports creating curriculums, managing players, enrolling children, and working the daily task list. Connect an MCP-compatible client such as Claude Code using an API key from your account settings.

Endpoint: `https://lessonhollow.com/api/mcp`

## Open Source

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/sallycole/lessonhollow): Full source code, curriculum CSV examples, and format documentation. MIT license.
- [Curriculum CSV Examples](https://github.com/sallycole/lessonhollow/tree/main/public/curriculums): Ready-to-import curriculum files.
- [CSV Format Specification](https://github.com/sallycole/lessonhollow/blob/main/docs/csv-format-gt2.md): Full documentation of the curriculum CSV format.
